svg.title: LEVEL 1-3: BoardroomAI — An AI board of directors for startup founders
svg.desc: BoardroomAI, An AI board of directors for startup founders. Live demo. Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Groq, Supabase. A founder pitches once and eight AI executives (CEO, CTO, CFO, CMO, VC, Legal, Research, Growth) debate it live, vote, and hand back an execution plan. https://github.com/rokadepiyush49-rgb/BoardroomAI, https://rokadepiyush49-rgb.github.io/BoardroomAI/
